citation.title: Accelerating cell topology optimisation by leveraging similarity in the parametric input space
citation.authors: Á. Martínez-Martínez, D. Muñoz, José Manuel Navarro-Jiménez, Olivier Allix, Francisco Chinesta, Juan José Ródenas, Enrique Nadal Soriano

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (no full text). The abstract says an instance-based model, using vector- or energy-based similarity of input parameters, warm-starts SIMP cell optimisation in a two-level framework and reduces computation time; no number is given.
